title: Reflect footer
description: A calm dark footer under a hairline with a faint violet glow at its top centre: the app-icon tile and name with small social icons below them at the left, three link columns at the right (ink titles, muted links on a 40px rhythm), then a newsletter row (24px heading and note on the left, email field and dark button on the right) between hairlines, and a legal line with dot-separated links and the copyright. Links brighten from 60% to 70% ink in 450ms; the field lightens on hover. On phones everything stacks and the form fills the width.
notes: the form is a plain HTML form; give newsletter.action a URL to post to
